observed_events.description: The right hand moves an orange and black broad retractable straight-bladed utility knife against a transparent ruler along straight marks on corrugated board.
The knife is set down. Both hands lift and fold the same board into an open hollow shape.
The wearer reaches for a yellow adhesive tape dispenser, tears off clear tape, and applies it to the folded seam. The knife remains a separate tool.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you add a spare of the tool in my right hand to my cart?
screening.source_continuity: Continuous 194–264 s, one original recording and no skipped footage; user asks only once.

supported_claims.text: The wearer holds and uses a broad straight-bladed hand utility knife in the right hand against a straightedge on corrugated board.
The same board is then folded and taped. The knife is set down and the yellow dispenser is used for assembly.

construct.research_question: Does an agent retain a grounded earlier purchase request when the wearer puts the cutting tool down and uses another tool on the same workpiece?
construct.belief_before: The right-hand tool actively cuts or scores straight lines in corrugated board: a manual utility knife, not the ruler or idle scissors.
construct.belief_after: The wearer folds and tapes the same board; the first requested tool is still the earlier utility knife.
construct.required_behavior_change: Retain or select an applicable straight-bladed hand utility knife; do not replace it with the later dispenser or add a second listing.
construct.no_update_failure: Selecting a powered cutter, children’s saw, unsupported accessory, or dispenser fails the original purchase.
construct.overupdate_failure: Swap an already valid utility knife for the tape dispenser or leave both in the cart after assembly starts.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request specifies only the tool in the right hand when spoken. Distinguishing a freehand knife from multiple other cutting tools and assembly supplies depends on the first-person view.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you add a spare of the tool in my right hand to my cart?

observed.why: The right hand holds the manual utility knife and draws it along the ruler.
The board is folded and soon taped, but the one-time request remains anchored to the original cutting tool.
